page: Microsoft Azure L2aos_v5 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Laosv5 server family. Powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 8.0 GB per core.

A primary characteristic of this server type is its storage configuration. It includes 1440 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable. This high ratio of local solid-state storage relative to the compute footprint provides significant resource density for storage-bound workloads without requiring external disk attachments.

Given the combination of 2 dedicated vCPUs, 16.0 GB of RAM, and 1440 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, the L2aos_v5 is structured for database hosting, caching layers, and applications requiring fast local temporary storage. The lack of a GPU and the modest CPU core count make it less suitable for parallel compute-heavy tasks or machine learning training, but highly efficient for localized, storage-intensive operations.
description: Microsoft Azure L2aos_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the Laosv5 family, running on AMD processors under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance is equipped with 1440 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage, offering exceptional local storage density relative to its compute footprint. With no integrated GPU and a compact CPU configuration, this server is designed for storage-dense and memory-aligned workloads. It is highly suited for database hosting, local caching, and transactional applications that require high-speed local read and write operations without the overhead of larger compute instances.
